pr_title: Simplify the testCancelViaTasksAPI test in CrossClusterAsyncSearchIT
pr_body:
The test may have been failing on flaky test conditions around failed shards. 
The key focus of this test is to ensure that a cross-cluster async search can
be cancelled, so the asserts have been simplified to focus on that goal only.

Closes #100957

comments:
From what I can tell, this test fails because it wasn't expecting any failed shards. Looking at the logs, I cannot tell why a particular shard failed, but it could very well be an flaky test issue. I would not expect this to be reflected in production.

Marking as medium-risk as the test isn't muted (thus not losing coverage), and it seems like the failure itself is related to test set up and such, not a real production issue.

> Reproduces locally?:
> Yes

I am unable to get it to reproduce locally after several attempts with the provided seed.

This further supports Ben's point that it is a likely a test setup issue.
The provided stack trace also does not match the code in main any longer, so it is unclear what line was failing.

review_comments: what type of flaky failures are we ignoring? I wonder if this may hide bugs somehow, although I agree that it is not the main purpose of this test to uncover those.

The issues are not reproducible in any useful way and there are general problems with cancellation and IT tests in general. The goal of this test was to ensure that cross-cluster searches get cancelled. So either it stays muted until the general cancellation IT test issues are fixed or we relax this test to focus on the key feature. Armin and others have been working on the tests focused on testing cancellation features per se. 

In addition, if there are sporadic shard failures during a cancellation, even if they are caused by a bug, they seem low priority to me, since the search was cancelled and the results are useless.
